title: petroleumCuts operation
description: Cut a TRUE-BOILING-POINT curve into petroleum PSEUDO-COMPONENTS (Riazi, ASTM MNL50, 2005).  Each cut's Tb is the TBP temperature at the mid-point of its distilled interval; its SG is one declared method (constantWatsonK, or declared per cut); the pair (Tb, SG) goes to the same Riazi-Daubert estimator estimateComponent uses (MW, Tc, Pc, Vc; omega by Lee-Kesler; Cp by Kesler-Lee).  One ESTIMATE record per cut is written into the CASE, marked lumped and NOT a real species -- a proposal the student reviews and promotes, never a standard record.  API gravity, SG (60/60 F) and Watson K are published per cut and for the blend; the re-blended cuts must reproduce the feed SG within a DECLARED tolerance, and a miss is announced, never adjusted.  The curve type is TBP: ASTM D86, D1160, D2887 and EFV refuse by name (the conversion is not implemented).

curve.title: TBP curve
curve.description: `{ type TBP; basis volume|mass; points ( { fraction f; T <value> C; } ... ); }` -- the distilled fraction in [0, 1] on the DECLARED basis against the true boiling temperature.  At least 3 points; both columns must strictly increase.  The curve need not reach 0 and 1: it must cover the cuts' mid-points, because nothing is extrapolated.

type.title: Curve type
type.description: TBP only; any other word refuses by name.

feed.title: Feed specific gravity
feed.description: Exactly one of `specificGravity <SG 60/60 F>;` or `specificGravityFrom TBP;` (Riazi Eq. 3.17, TBP row of Table 3.4: SG = 0.10431 T10^0.1255 T50^0.20862, T in K; needs a volume-basis curve covering 10 and 50 %).

cuts.title: Cuts
cuts.description: `boundaries ( 0 0.1 ... 1 );` -- increasing distilled fractions from exactly 0 to exactly 1 (the cuts partition the whole feed; a different end refuses 'cut fractions do not sum to 1') -- or `number N;` for N cuts of equal width.

specificGravity.title: Cut specific gravity
specificGravity.description: `method constantWatsonK;` -- SG_i = (1.8 Tb_i)^(1/3)/Kw with ONE Kw for the feed (Riazi Eq. 2.13 rearranged; Kw at the feed SG and the feed's MeABP, Eq. 3.3-3.5, by fixed point): an ASSUMPTION of this op, not a recommendation of the book.  Or `method declared; values ( ... );` with one SG per cut.

closure.title: Closure tolerance
closure.description: `specificGravityTolerance <relative>;` -- REQUIRED.  The tolerance within which the cuts re-blended by Eq. 3.45 must reproduce the feed SG.  Outside it the run says so and publishes closure.ok = 0; nothing is adjusted.

output.title: Output
output.description: `proposal auto;` writes one constant/components/<prefix>_NN.estimated.dat per cut (or `proposal <directory>;`); `prefix <word>;` names them (default petCut); `file <name>;` writes the cut table as CSV.  Writing under data/standards/ is refused.
